rule.task-small.label: Task · standard
rule.task-small.detail: After independent acceptance of a goal linked to the program. Shared task pool per goal: up to 30 pts.
rule.task-large.label: Task · demanding
rule.task-large.detail: Scale approved by another person before starting. Shared task pool per goal: up to 30 pts.
rule.goal-small.label: Goal with proof · standard
rule.goal-small.detail: A goal linked to the program, with substantial proof and acceptance by another Founder/Admin or an assigned mentor. Up to min_count goals per condition.
rule.goal-large.label: Goal with proof · demanding
rule.goal-large.detail: The scale is set by another Founder/Admin or a mentor before starting; the result needs independent acceptance and free room in the condition's limit.
rule.document.label: Document used in the work
rule.document.detail: A non-empty file used in an accepted goal. Uploading alone doesn't score. Up to 30 pts a day; the surplus goes to the queue.
rule.point.label: Program point
rule.point.detail: A 25-pt pool shared in the team. Real progress and independent acceptance of each part. Personal bonus once across all teams.
rule.stage.label: Program stage
rule.stage.detail: A 150-pt pool shared in the team for an actually completed stage, also if the work started before SCORE was introduced. Independent acceptance.
rule.feedback.label: Useful feedback
rule.feedback.detail: The recipient confirmed its value. Once per item, up to 15 pts a day.
rule.help.label: Confirmed help
rule.help.detail: Help with a result confirmed by the recipient. Up to 20 pts a day.
scoreControls.reviewIntro: Accept a specific outcome after checking the proof. You don't accept your own reward. Justification: at least 80 characters and 12 words; confirming the status alone isn't enough.
scoreControls.rereview: Re-review of changed tasks. The goal keeps its status; points awarded earlier aren't counted a second time.
page.legacy: We kept {legacy} pts earned before independent verification. They're part of the account's history; they don't raise your verified rank or reputation.
page.awaitingHint: Ask another Founder/Admin or an assigned program mentor to check the result in SCORE. A Founder without an Admin can get a mentor's acceptance; you don't approve your own points.
page.fairRules: Skip, upload, empty file, sign-in and swipe give 0 pts. Goals and tasks reward the owner after independent acceptance. The number of scoring goals is limited by the program condition's min_count. The limit is shared by the team and includes pending rewards. Extra goals don't give points for themselves, their tasks or documents. Re-reviewing new tasks doesn't require reopening the goal and doesn't award its reward again. The task budget stays at up to 30 pts per goal for the whole team. The point pool (25) and stage pool (150) are split equally among team members at completion; leftover single points are assigned in a fixed order of identifiers. Whoever closes it gets no extra bonus. Each person receives the bonus for a given point and stage only once, across all teams. A skip alone gives no reward. The stage bonus checks actual progress, also from before SCORE was introduced. Daily: tasks 60, goals 200, documents 30, program points 50, stages 150; up to 260 work SCORE in total. The surplus goes to the queue. Reputation: feedback 15, help 20 a day, up to 10 from one person in 7 days, no mutual rating exchange. Reputation deliberately doesn't affect your work rank. The day is settled in Europe/Warsaw time. Changing a period, spacing or letter case doesn't create a new text proof.
